items.title: Arsan Tekstil Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi Leads 3 Middle Eastern Penny Stocks To Watch
items.summary: The Middle Eastern stock markets have recently shown resilience, with most Gulf markets gaining due to easing geopolitical tensions and Egypt's index reaching a record high. In this context, penny stocks—often representing smaller or newer companies—remain an intriguing investment area despite being considered somewhat outdated.
